top_categories.workout_context: 60ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
De Ronde Van Grampian's 99% gravel roads, Rolling Oakland and Lapeer County roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 52 miles.
At De Ronde Van Grampian, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of De Ronde Van Grampian. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic De Ronde Van Grampian's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
52 miles on rolling Michigan gravel with a technical finish burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on rolling Michigan gravel with a technical finish demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
When someone attacks on rolling Michigan gravel with a technical finish, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At De Ronde Van Grampian, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for De Ronde Van Grampian. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work for 3,123ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for De Ronde Van Grampian’s 50 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at De Ronde Van Grampian requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on michigan rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: michigan rolling, local event, midwest gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 52 miles of rolling michigan gravel with a technical finish in Oxford, Michigan.
